selection_method.provider_eligibility: At least one native completion in the earlier smoke campaign (13 complete providers and 8 partial providers).
selection_method.native_completion_seed: Keep every executable game with at least one complete mode from the earlier campaign, including its previously failing implemented modes.
selection_method.mode_diversity: Add games to cover every implemented mode type present in each eligible provider. RubyPlay additionally covers every implemented purchase selector (freespin, respin, minispin and select). Prefer the largest number of newly covered families, then the stable selection hash.
selection_method.remaining_games: Rank executable games by implemented-mode count, then SHA-256; divide rank into four quartiles using 1+floor(4*rank/count). Repeatedly pick from the least represented nonempty quartile, tie by quartile number then selection hash, until 10 distinct games are selected.
selection_method.scope: All implemented modes of every selected game, one sample per mode; native continuation steps up to 512. Unknown continuations remain partial. No fabricated actions or closures.
selection_method.unsupported_policy: Declared separately. They are not implemented attempts and remain visible because modes=[] keeps the complete catalog selection.
